title: Dealing with blood clots in lung left Taylor Moton with "attitude of gratitude" for chance to return

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dealing with blood clots in lung left Taylor Moton with "attitude of gratitude" for chance to return
sources.description: Panthers offensive tackle Taylor Moton began "thinking the worst" when he coughed up blood in June and a trip to the hospital showed that he had "a multitude of clots" in his right lung.
